root_cause: Canonical cycle events have no source-native actor/skill/before/after. Composer already measures qv.score but previously wrote no actor identity or prior-vs-new score provenance, and ignored Supabase quality-evidence upsert errors.
fix: Attach source-owned message-composition agent_id, exact CONTRACT as skill_version, real prior recorded numeric score or null, computed current score, and exact authoritative message-quality evidence ref to existing powerhouse_sales_actions.evidence.commercial_intelligence.composer. Fail closed if quality table write fails. Do not assert delivery, customer outcome or revenue.
privacy: No new PII, no token or raw customer payload in browser; action evidence remains in existing protected source.
risk: This improves the producer's own evidence, but does not retroactively populate immutable cycle_events, prove other agent identities or write provider outcomes.
next: Extend canonical stage-appropriate cycle event producers under protected DB migration and independently validate exact live source quality and customer outcome attribution.
prevention_rule: Composer source updates must fail closed if its authoritative quality-row upsert fails. Only the actual scoped composer writer may state its own actor/skill; before_score requires prior recorded numeric evidence, after_score derives from the current computation. Never infer provider send, lead, order or paid revenue, and do not rewrite canonical historical cycle events.
